Action/scope source: > For a missing compute-spend export, create exactly one primary meter attributed to the original support source charge and period. The official export evidence must exist before recording it. Copied provider-export physical quantities in support_service_record are reconciliation evidence, not accounting postings. No support commitment or portfolio discount applies to this on-demand reconciliation scope. The latest billing review by occurred_at identifies the precise original source charge and its service period. Select the same-customer active compute contract with the same billing_entity; use its approved negotiated_unit_rate, otherwise its tier unit_rate. If there is no matching compute contract, the reconstructed compute rate is zero and no compute-spend contribution is recognized. For these on-demand compute export reconstructions, an approved negotiated rate receives no further discount; otherwise an eligible compute promotion reduces the compute price by that compute tier promotion_discount, and an absent or expired promotion gives zero discount. Multiply the selected compute unit price once by one minus its applicable compute discount to obtain the effective cloud rate; all source intervals in this reconciliation use us_east and on-demand standard configuration. Sum completed primary support spending export quantity in vcpu_hour for the selected original charge and period; rejected exports and supplemental baseline exports are excluded. Multiply missing exported vCPU-hours by the effective cloud rate to obtain missing eligible supported_usd spending. Floor missing eligible spending at zero, then round only the resulting supported_usd quantity half up to six decimal places. For the single aggregated missing-spend meter, copy support_event_id exactly from the selected latest billing review's related_event_id, and store that same reference as the new meter's related_event_id. This review-designated export is the sole evidence locator for the aggregate; every qualifying export fragment still contributes its quantity, but no other fragment's identifier may substitute as the locator.

Bearing prose [Enterprise Support: Missing-spend recognition](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/missing_spend_action_2c0b0049.json):

> Enterprise Support — Missing-spend recognition.
> 
> ## Action
> 
> For a missing support spending export, create exactly one primary meter attributed to the original support source charge and period.
> 
> ## Capability
> 
> Record an agent's measured eligible-spending contribution for a support invoice source. The contract gains a posted primary consumption entry; success supplies its reference and recorded quantity, which are immediately visible in consumption history.
> 
> ## Invocation
> 
> recognize_support_spend_78bce399 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.
> 
> ## Parameters
> 
> - `customer_id`: Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located customer profile.
> 
> - `support_holding_id`: Id class — support contract reference number copied from the contract lookup.
> 
> - `support_event_id`: Id class — review-designated official spending export reference number copied exactly from the selected latest billing review's related evidence reference returned by support event lookup; this identifies the aggregate's evidence locator, and another export fragment's identifier is not a substitute.
> 
> - `source_event_id`: Id class — original support invoice-line reference number copied from the retrieved export.
> 
> - `quantity`: Fixed-format class — eligible spending in supported_usd, format Decimal quantity to six decimal places; unit as specified, rounded half up before submission; the submitted value is stored at six-place precision.
> 
> - `period`: Fixed-format class — service billing month in YYYY-MM format, UTC calendar month; an empty value is not allowed.
> 
> - `interval_start`: Fixed-format class — inclusive service start as format ISO timestamp or empty string in UTC, with second precision; an empty value is not allowed.
> 
> - `interval_end`: Fixed-format class — exclusive service end as format ISO timestamp or empty string in UTC, with second precision; an empty value is not allowed.
> 
> ## Return
> 
> A success string containing the created consumption reference as a string and the recorded eligible supported spending in USD quantity as a six-place decimal; 'Spending recorded' confirms that the contribution is posted.

PASS: action, admissible scope, exact reference flow and capability have their quoted source rule/tool contract; no extra prerequisite is inferred from capability success.

This review-designated export is the sole evidence locator for the aggregate; every qualifying export fragment still contributes its quantity, but no other fragment's identifier may substitute as the locator.

Bearing prose [Enterprise Support: Source-line debit assessment](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/invoice_debit_action_7b5b224e.json):

> Enterprise Support — Source-line debit assessment.
> 
> ## Action
> 
> This source-specific debit does not request a refund.
> 
> ## Capability
> 
> Post an agent's untaxed correction debit for an original support invoice line. The contract receivable increases by the submitted USD amount, with the same pretax component and zero tax. Success supplies the debit reference and the posted amount, immediately visible in accounting history.
> 
> ## Invocation
> 
> debit_support_invoice_804a8331 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.
> 
> ## Parameters
> 
> - `customer_id`: Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located profile.
> 
> - `support_holding_id`: Id class — support contract reference number copied from the retrieved original invoice.
> 
> - `support_event_id`: Id class — approved review reference number copied from support event lookup or its completion receipt.
> 
> - `source_event_id`: Id class — original invoice-line reference number copied from that review.
> 
> - `related_event_id`: Id class — official source export reference number copied from that review.
> 
> - `amount`: Fixed-format class — positive receivable correction in USD, format USD to two decimals; unit USD, rounded half up before submission; storage preserves cents.
> 
> - `period`: Fixed-format class — source service billing month in YYYY-MM format, UTC calendar month; an empty value is not allowed.
> 
> ## Return
> 
> A success string giving the created debit reference as a string and posted USD amount as a two-place decimal; 'Debit posted' confirms that the receivable correction is saved.

PASS: action, admissible scope, exact reference flow and capability have their quoted source rule/tool contract; no extra prerequisite is inferred from capability success.

#### support_evt_meter

Home: [Enterprise Support: Provider consumption evidence](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/evt_meter_da33c20b.json), Policy clauses / Authoritative evidence / Measurement basis as applicable.

Source rule:

> The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Meters originate in the provider resource export. Primary meter quantities use usage_unit; a meter is positive and a meter_reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed. Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference. bill_actual overage permits measured quantities above included_quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write. Round measured quantities to quantity_precision using rounding_mode, apply minimum_quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter_quantum. Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental_meter. A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter. Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

> Enterprise Support — Provider consumption evidence.
> 
> ## Policy clauses
> 
> The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.
> 
> Meters originate in the provider resource export.
> 
> Primary meter quantities use usage unit; a meter is positive and a consumption reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed.
> 
> Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference.
> 
> billing of actual measured overage overage permits measured quantities above included quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write.
> 
> Round measured quantities to meter quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter quantum.
> 
> Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental consumption entry.
> 
> A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter.
> 
> Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.
> 
> ## Authoritative evidence
> 
> The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, external reference, inclusive service start, exclusive service end, quantity. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

#### support_evt_tax

Source rule:

> The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Use the source contract tax_treatment reviewed at the service date and tax_rates. Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using amount_precision and rounding_mode. For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment. Tax credits have negative tax_amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax_amount. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are POLICY_NOT_COVERED, not assumed exempt. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

#### support_evt_correction

Home: [Enterprise Support: Source-line invoice corrections](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/evt_correction_3a59e84a.json), Policy clauses / Authoritative evidence / Measurement basis as applicable.

Source rule:

> For source_subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source_subtype values. Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net_amount plus tax_amount, following evt_tax. Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison. Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal. A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction. An upward correction carries positive amount. Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved. No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction. Link source_event_id to the original charge and related_event_id to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines. Use correction_gross from msr_source_credits for the correction comparison; service_credit_net never changes the approved corrected billing target.

#### support_evt_service_credit

Home: [Enterprise Support: Outage claim credits](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/evt_service_credit_1e4c6ee8.json), Policy clauses / Authoritative evidence / Measurement basis as applicable.

Source rule:

> For a service_credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive credited_amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service_credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit_claim_days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, frozen handling time is its notice_at; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded notice_at to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit_claim_days UTC calendar dates to incident_closed_at, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage_exclusions. Availability at or above sla_target_percent gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending sla_credit_bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability_percent. Multiply the original source charge net_amount by that fraction; subtract the service_credit_net component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit_cap_fraction of that original net amount. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with amount_precision and rounding_mode. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source_subtype service_credit; evt_correction applies only to source_subtype correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive credited_amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

#### support_evt_category_meters

Home: [Enterprise Support: Support service and ancillary meters](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/evt_category_meters_04e3eada.json), Policy clauses / Authoritative evidence / Measurement basis as applicable.

Source rule:

> The selected spend_band_usd is the plan reference, not an included monetary credit. Primary supported_usd quantity is eligible pre-tax cloud service spending net of correction credits, grouped by billing_entity and month; service-credit concessions, support fees, taxes and cash remittances are excluded. marketplace_included decides whether marketplace lines enter that base. Charge the greater of minimum_monthly_fee and eligible supported_usd times the effective unit_rate after the ordinary non-stacked discount selection, prorating the minimum by actual active seconds in the UTC month for partial-month service. An approved annual support-spend commitment uses reservation_discounts for its covered spend; a promotion, portfolio discount or negotiated percentage instead follows evt_pricing priority. No discount reduces the minimum_monthly_fee, which remains the last floor applied to the monthly net fee. The source commitment is a signed support-spend obligation, never an infrastructure reservation borrowed from a different category. named_contacts bills contacts above included_contacts at additional_contact_fee per contact-month. architecture_reviews bills completed reviews above included_reviews at extra_review_fee. onsite_days bills authorized delivered consultant-days at onsite_day_fee. Record measured first-response times against critical_response_minutes, high_response_minutes and normal_response_hours using incident-created UTC time to first human response elapsed time; these are service targets, not extra usage fees. dedicated_manager controls whether a named technical account manager can be assigned; without entitlement the assignment is refused and there is no substitute charge. Service_record records these entitlements and actual delivery, never an invented cash credit for a missed response. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using amount_precision and rounding_mode and tax under evt_tax. An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval_start then source_event_id within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are POLICY_NOT_COVERED instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included_quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

>     source_event_id: Id class — original support invoice-line reference number copied from the retrieved export.
>     quantity: Fixed-format class — eligible spending in supported_usd, format Decimal quantity to six decimal places; unit as specified, rounded half up before submission; the submitted value is stored at six-place precision.
>     period: Fixed-format class — service billing month in YYYY-MM format, UTC calendar month; an empty value is not allowed.
>     interval_start: Fixed-format class — inclusive service start as format ISO timestamp or empty string in UTC, with second precision; an empty value is not allowed.
>     interval_end: Fixed-format class — exclusive service end as format ISO timestamp or empty string in UTC, with second precision; an empty value is not allowed.
> 
> Returns:
>     A success string containing the created consumption reference as a string and the recorded supported_usd quantity as a six-place decimal; 'Spending recorded' confirms that the contribution is posted.
